name: Michelle Amerta de Jong
source:
A bubbly girl who won't let the world dampen her enthusiasm. She's an optimist, yet very naive. Amerta always tries to befriend everyone.

[From [url=https://syllphana.itch.io/for-amerta]itch.io[/url]]
